capabilities.intent: What public business contact and qualification evidence exists for these supplied company domains?
capabilities.delivers: Source-backed company enrichment and qualified public business contact rows

price.charge_trigger: Charged once for each delivered, source-checked lead that matches the requested criteria. Unqualified or unavailable leads are free.

input_schema.title: B2B Lead Finder — Verified Company Enrichment
input_schema.description: Use query + max_results to discover, or companies to enrich. Unsupported criteria remain unknown rather than being invented.

query.title: Describe the businesses to find
query.description: Experimental provider-led discovery using documented filters only; source coverage and provider costs require validation. Prefer mode=enrich with supplied domains for the initial supported workflow. Unsupported criteria remain unknown.

max_results.title: Maximum qualified leads
max_results.description: Target maximum. One run checks at most 120 candidates; larger requests return a partial report and require batching.

companies.title: Companies to enrich
companies.description: Array of objects with website and/or name. This selects enrich mode by default. At most five companies may omit a website per run because each name requires a separate paid search-provider call; provide domains for larger batches.

website.title: Company website
website.description: Public company website URL or domain.

domains.title: Website domains to enrich
domains.description: Simple list of company domains or URLs. This also selects enrich mode.

exclude_lead_ids.title: Lead IDs already received
exclude_lead_ids.description: Optional lead_id values from previous runs. Matching leads are skipped and are never counted as billable results. Keep this list in your agent's own state for cross-run deduplication.

mode.title: Workflow
mode.description: enrich checks supplied companies/domains; discover searches supported providers. Providing companies or domains selects enrich by default.

industry.title: Industry or category
industry.description: Requested business category. It must match observed category or labeled website evidence; unknown category cannot qualify a lead.

location.title: Location
location.description: Requested city/region. Qualification needs sourced address fields; a domain extension is not location evidence. Broad continental regions remain unknown.

country.title: Country
country.description: Requested explicit country name or ISO country code. Checked against source-stated country/address evidence; never inferred from a domain suffix or phone prefix. Contradictions remain unknown.

minimum_rating.title: Minimum public rating
minimum_rating.description: Minimum source-provided rating from 0 to 5. Missing ratings remain unknown and cannot pass this criterion.

minimum_review_count.title: Minimum review count
minimum_review_count.description: Minimum source-provided review count. Missing counts remain unknown; website contact information does not establish reviews.

website_required.title: Require live website
website_required.description: Require a checked live public website. This verifies website availability, not current business operation.

email_required.title: Require public business email
email_required.description: Require an observed public business email. Publication is checked; mailbox ownership and deliverability are not tested.

contact_required.title: Require public business contact
contact_required.description: Require at least one verified public business email or phone number. Use email_required and phone_required together only when both are needed.

phone_required.title: Require public phone
phone_required.description: Require an observed public business phone number. Publication is checked; the number is not called.

social_profile_required.title: Require public social profile
social_profile_required.description: Require at least one observed linked public social profile. Profile ownership and activity are not independently verified.

exclude_chains.title: Prefer likely independent businesses
exclude_chains.description: An inference from public signals; not proof of ownership.

exclude_booking.title: Exclude obvious online booking
exclude_booking.description: No observed booking link is not proof no booking exists.

keywords.title: Required keywords
keywords.description: Phrases required in the sourced company name, description or category. Phrase matching is explicit; no latent purchase intent is inferred.

exclude_keywords.title: Excluded keywords
exclude_keywords.description: Phrases that disqualify a company when present in its sourced name, description or category. Missing descriptive content remains unknown.

discovery_source.title: Discovery source
discovery_source.description: auto uses bounded Maps and Search discovery. A specific maps, search, or osm value uses only that source family; osm does not silently launch paid Maps or Search providers. OSM is explicit-only while public Overpass availability is unreliable.

include_unqualified.title: Include rejected or unknown candidates
include_unqualified.description: Return additional audit rows when true. Only qualification.qualified=true rows count as paid qualified-lead events.

include_hiring_signal.title: Hiring signal (experimental)
include_hiring_signal.description: Reserved; currently reported as unsupported and never inferred.

technology.title: Technology
technology.description: Look for explicit website technology signals.

active_required.title: Require evidence of current activity
active_required.description: Require verified current operation. A live website alone is only a low-confidence inference, so this criterion remains unknown and the lead is not qualified without stronger evidence.

report.title: Full structured report
report.description: JSON report with source scope, qualification counts, errors and lead rows.

leads.title: Lead rows
leads.description: Structured qualified business rows in the default dataset.

billing.title: Actual platform event receipt
billing.description: Actual accepted qualified-lead count; not confirmation of customer revenue.

capabilities.verification_scope: Source-backed company enrichment and qualified public business contact rows
capabilities.coverage_limits: A supplied-domain check does not identify people, verify mailbox deliverability or prove buying intent. Qualification follows the stated criteria and checked public sources.

selection.choose_when: A known-company enrichment queue needs public business contact and fit evidence.
do_not_choose_for: Discovering all companies in a market
Personal email or decision-maker identity verification
selection.example_note: Dated owner-funded test; verify current terms and output before use.

company_website.title: Official company website

predicate.title: Claim to verify
predicate.description: A documented capability, not operational API access, program acceptance, or successful integration setup.

target.title: Integration name
target.description: Required only for integration_documented. Omit for other claims.

source_url.title: Optional direct official source

report.title: JSON report

dataset.title: Report dataset

billing.title: Event receipt
billing.description: charged_count 0 or 1 after acknowledgment; null requires reconciliation. Owner tests are not customer sales.

error.title: Structured error
error.description: Present after a contract, storage or billing failure. Do not automatically retry an uncertain payment.

capabilities.verification_scope: A scoped claim status with supporting or conflicting official evidence
capabilities.coverage_limits: Official documentation does not prove that an integration works in a customer account, and a missing mention is not global proof of absence.
